last_message:
Tests pass. Docs are updated:

- **`docs/adr/0001-keep-sessions-in-signed-cookies.md`** (renamed from `...in-the-database.md`, kept ADR #1): edited in place per the "changed decision" rule — `Context` gained the August 2026 disk-full outage, `Options` gained the nightly-job and signed-cookie alternatives considered in `notes/issue-63.md`, and `Decision`/`Consequences` now describe the cookie-based scheme and its tradeoffs (no server-side logout, key rotation logs everyone out).
- **`docs/adr/README.md`**: guide entry updated to the new title/link.
- **`docs/features/sessions.md`**: `Storage` section rewritten for the cookie mechanism; added a `Known limits` section for the two real limitations (no server-side single-member logout, key rotation logs everyone out).
- **`docs/architecture.md`**: "how they connect" now says sessions live in signed cookies, not Postgres.

`docs/runbooks/gateway-timeouts.md` and `docs/glossary.md` didn't reference the sessions table, so nothing there needed changing.
